programme.title: K-CULTURE DIVE [L]
programme.desc: K-CULTURE DIVE

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Beauty On and Off
programme.desc: K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing. So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: Beauty On and Off
programme.desc: K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing. So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: TALK ROOM
programme.desc: What is the true strength of the K-people leading the K-Wave? We invite the most talked-about figures—those who influence not just Korea but the world—into our studio for intimate one-on-one conversations. Through their stories, the secrets behind overcoming failure and achieving success, and even private small talk, we uncover what makes them extraordinary. When you listen to someone’s story, you enter their world. In this time of dialogue with the most Korean yet most global K-people, we step into the K-Universe.

programme.title: WITH SCIENCE, WE LIVE
programme.desc: Humanity has learned from the past, transcended the present, and dreamed of the future."With Science, We Live"explores the frontiers of science alongside some of the world’s leading thinkers, offering insights into what lies ahead and uncovering new possibilities.In an era of rapid change, where are we headed?As we navigate between the vast universe and the smallness of human existence, we reconsider the direction we must take.Now, in this very moment, we imagine the future shaped by our choices—and move forward toward it.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: It's been a week of great consequence for the media. On Monday, Russell Brand was sentenced to over ten years in prison for rape and sexual assault. On Tuesday - in a separate story - ITV News and The Guardian named David Walliams as the celebrity who tried to use an injunction to block the publication of sexual misconduct allegations. Our panel discusses the issues raised: Rosamund Urwin, chief news correspondent at The Sunday Times; Alex Wilson, partner at RPC, and Sarah Ditum, author of Toxic: Women, Fame and The Noughties.

programme.title: The Interface
programme.desc: A wave of fridge and freezer hacks in Europe could be a sign of something much bigger. Thomas Germain and Jessica Maddox ask whether we're heading for a 'hackpocalypse', a world where AI helps almost anyone find and exploit old security flaws. Plus, Google says that US schools can now switch off AI on student Chromebooks, but if they do, kids will lose access to Google Search. Google says the two are now too closely linked to separate - and the changes give schools more choice. Tom and Jess dig into why it's a controversial move, what it says about Google's grip on American schools, and what it could mean for Big Tech at a time when the public is losing patience with AI.

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator MMA comes to Sioux Falls as South Dakota native Logan Storley looks to extend his undefeated streak as he takes on the always dangerous AJ Matthews. Bantamweight king Darrion Caldwell moves up to featherweight to face Noad.

programme.title: Bellator 205: McKee vs Macapa
programme.desc: Bellator MMA comes to Boise, Idaho with an explosive featherweight main event as rising star AJ McKee takes on dangerous veteran John Macapa. Also looking to stay undefeated is Rafael Lovato Jr. as he faces fellow submission specialist John Salter.

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator MMA comes to San Jose. Legends Rampage Jackson and Wanderlei Silva settle the score with a rematch ten years in the making. Finally, in the main event Gegard Mousasi defends his Middleweight belt against Rory MacDonald.

programme.title: Bellator 207: Mitrione vs Bader
programme.desc: Bellator MMA returns to Mohegan Sun as Matt Mitrione faces off against Ryan Bader in the Heavyweight World Grand Prix semifinals. Roy “Big County” Nelson takes on dangerous Russian Sergei Kharitonov, and top welterweight contender Lorenz Larkin returns.

programme.title: Bellator 208: Fedor vs Sonnen
programme.desc: Bellator MMA invades Long Island as MMA legend Fedor Emelianenko takes on the American Gangster Chael Sonnen with the winner advancing to the finals of the Heavyweight World Grand Prix. Also, Benson Henderson and Cheick Kongo return to the cage.

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator MMA returns to Israel with a featherweight world title fight as Patricio Pitbull puts the belt on the line against Emmanuel Sanchez. Also Light Heavyweights Phil Davis takes on Vadim Nemkov.

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator returns to Thackerville as John Salter and Chidi Njokuani face off in a pivotal middleweight showdown.

programme.title: Bellator MMA Full Fight Cards
programme.desc: Bellator crosses the Atlantic to bring viewers an action-packed card from Genoa, Italy! The main event sees hometown hero and Italian superstar Alessio Sakara take on Kent Kauppinen in a matchup of light heavyweights.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Talk To Dr. Phil Or We're Done Pt. 1
programme.desc: For the past 2 years Nancy has been in an online relationship with "Shaun" she says is an honest and loving man. Her son Darcy says Nancy doesn't even know what he looks like! Nancy is adamant she is not being scammed in this catfish story of online love.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Missing "Van Life" Woman's Father Speaks Out: The Dr. Phil Interview Pt. 1
programme.desc: A father pleads for help regarding his missing daughter. Gabby Petito, 22, set off on a van trip with her fiancé, but two months later he returned alone. Police revealed the couple had an incident--caught on camera. Gabby's dad is determined to find her.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Susan Powell, a beautiful mother of two, vanished in 2009. Her husband, Josh, was considered a person of interest & what began as an unsolved mystery tragically ended with the murder-suicide of Josh Powell & their two sons, Charles, 7, & Braden, 5.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: We Escaped A Cult: Survivors Unite After 30 Years
programme.desc: As children they were forced into a religious sect that sexually abused them & controlled their lives. Now, 30 years after an intense police raid shut down "The Zion Society", some of its victims gather for the first time to share stories of survival.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: All My Ex Cares About Is Acting & Singing For The Lord Pt.1
programme.desc: Danielle & Brandon are in a custody war over their little daughter. Mom Danielle has visitation, & says her ex has threatened to kill her twice. Dad Brandon says Danielle is a terrible mother concerned with her 'nonexistent' acting/singing career. Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Our Mooching, Violent, Lazy Son Who Lives In Our Back Yard!
programme.desc: Mom Susan is desperate to help son, JJ, 27. She says JJ is a lazy, unemployed, violent moocher. Husband Steven, says his wife bought a camper & relocated JJ to the backyard, where she continues to bring food & money. That she's the "ultimate enabler".

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: From Hollywood Body Double To Force Feeding Frenzy
programme.desc: Over 10 years ago, Suzy says she developed a "mysterious illness" that leaves her shaking, trembling, convulsing and having to force-feed herself more than 7,000 calories a day to stop her "attacks"! What could this mysterious illness possibly be?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After 21 years, Paula is considering divorcing husband, Jeremy, saying he's "clueless, absent & non-verbal." Jeremy says it's Paula--controlling & a grudge-holder. Find out Jeremy's mistake. Dr. Phil and Robin share the secret to their 45-year marriage.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Is My Nigerian Boyfriend Scamming Me?
programme.desc: Josie, 64, says she has met the love of her life, Victor, on Facebook. He’s Nigerian, 30 years younger, she has never physically met him, yet insists it's true love. Dr. Phil took cameras to Nigeria to find Victor, to see if he’s telling Josie the truth.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Cindy tells her own alcohol history. Sarah emerges from her addiction haze. Dr. Phil reunites the twins with Perry, their father. Leaving The Dr. Phil House, a stop at the studios and a goodbye to Dr. Phil, the twins head to separate rehab centers. Part 3

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Love Scams: A Mother Hooked By A Catfish
programme.desc: Widow Sebrina, 56, says she’s in love with her overseas boyfriend, “James,” but they've never met. She sent him more than $250,000, emptying her life savings, with payback when they marry. Is she a catfish victim? Dr. Phil confronts “James” on the phone!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Women: Are you dying to know what men really think? Comedian and radio and TV host Steve Harvey has all the "manswers"! In his book, Straight Talk, No Chaser, Steve dishes the dirt about unlocking the male mind and understanding the male game.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Our Son: Violent Mooch Refusing To Get Out Of Our House Pt.1
programme.desc: Karen & Jim are desperate to remove their violent, mooching son, Kyle, 31, from their home. They filed a restraining order against him & had him arrested for criminal trespassing, but Kyle is still in their home. Kyle says his parents are to blame. Pt.1

programme.title: Sanford and Son
programme.desc: Angered by his father's constant interruption of his dates, Lamont moves out to pursue the life of a swinging bachelor. But much to Lamont's disappointment, it's the newly unchaperoned Fred who is besieged by the ladies.

programme.title: The Jeffersons
programme.desc: Jenny Jefferson's thesis research on street gangs teaches her and her family a horrifying lesson in life...and death.

programme.title: The Jeffersons
programme.desc: George riled by bare facts.

programme.title: The Jeffersons
programme.desc: Allan Willis, the 'white sheep' of the racially-mixed Willis family, arrives in town after several years absence and finds things just as he left them -- hostile -- in the first of a two-part story.

programme.title: The Jeffersons
programme.desc: Allan sees through George's scheme to con him out of his newly inherited warehouse, so George directs his flim-flammery at an alternate target -- Louise -- in the conclusion of a two-part story.

programme.title: The Jeffersons
programme.desc: George's unexpected offer to help Louise and Allan cut through the red tape that's delaying the move of the Help Center turns into more trouble than anyone is prepared to handle.

programme.title: The Jeffersons
programme.desc: Obsessed with landing a crucial new cleaning account, an overwrought and exhausted George lapses into sleep and wakes up to a terrifying look at his future.

programme.title: The Jeffersons
programme.desc: George is fascinated by a highly successful -- if unconventional -- stockbroker, until he finds out about his unusual medical past.

programme.title: The Jeffersons

programme.title: Moesha

programme.desc: With Anya in the hospital, O'S**t tries to fix his relationship. Sassy decides to introduce her new girlfriend to the crew. Meanwhile, Ceaser, Dutchess, & Ted go to Arizona to bring Sky home but find out Sky's facing 8 years in jail. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew Sky is the New Black
programme.desc: Ted's true feelings come to light upon Sky's 2-month sentence to Tent City, one of the most controversial jails in the world. Puma's business partner, Med, plays mediator trying to squash the beef and bring the old friends back together. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew Now It's Turned All The Way Up
programme.desc: Quani and Puma are officially "turned up", causing them to miss the Black Ink photo shoot. O'S**t heads to court to find out the outcome of his gun charge. Quani curses out Ceaser, causing a full-blown riot on the streets of Harlem. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew This is Not a Talk Show
programme.desc: The pressure is on for Ceaser when Dutchess' parents arrive for their engagement party. Quani and Puma make it clear that this war isn't over. Sky struggles with the emotions she feels over leaving Tent City. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Ryan toils in secrecy on a new mystery shop while Van scares some sense into his daughter's bae. Rising actor Don ponders a move to NYC. Phor shines in the studio while Charmaine wants answers about her future with 9MAG. Ryan debuts his dope new shop

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Ryan's all-new 9Mag shop is open for business with a fresh talent lineup. Van takes over the old shop by marking his territory with a new set of rules. Phor is back from hiatus and learns that not everyone has access to Ryan's new kingdom.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Van's leadership skills are put under the microscope, as the old shop continues to suffer. Meanwhile, Lily wonders if she still has a future at 9Mag. Charmaine's parents come to town and Phor receives a baller opportunity.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: When Ryan decides to treat the new 9Mag and old 9Mag to a team-building trip in Miami, Charmaine questions her future with 9Mag and an emotional Ryan releases some pent-up anger towards the OGs.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Mandatory team bonding in Miami pays off as Charmaine and Lily put years of beef behind them. Phor makes his triumphant return to the stage. When Lily lashes out at Neek, Ryan's hard-won 9MAG peace goes left. Charmaine faces a heartbreaking decision.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.sub-title: The Cover Up Is Worse Than The Crime

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew All You Did Was Mess Up My Hair

programme.title: Cheers: Norman und das Teufelsweib

programme.title: Cheers: Diane und der Maler – Teil 1
programme.desc: Sam und Diane sind mal wieder zerstritten. Um Diane zu versöhnen, engagiert Sam einen Maler, der sie porträtieren soll. Dieser ist von Diane hingerissen. Sam wird total eifersüchtig und verbietet Diane, Modell zu sitzen. Sie tut es trotzdem.

programme.title: Cheers: Diane und der Maler – Teil 2
programme.desc: Diane lässt sich von dem Maler Phillip porträtieren. Sam weiß davon nichts. Ahnungslos engagiert er per Annonce einen anderen Künstler, der Diane anhand eines Fotos malt. Mit dem Ergebnis erntet Sam großes Gelächter in der Bar. Auch Diane ist stinksauer.

programme.title: Cheers: Rückfall zu zweit – Teil 1
programme.desc: Nach dem letzten großen Krach mit Diane ist Sam erneut der Flasche verfallen. Diane überredet ihn deshalb, sich auf ein Gespräch mit Dr. Frasier Crane einzulassen. Sam glaubt, Diane wäre wieder in ihn verliebt.

programme.title: Cheers: Rückfall zu zweit – Teil 2
programme.desc: Sam hat sich von Frasier therapieren lassen. Inzwischen trinkt er auch nicht mehr und geht zu den Anonymen Alkoholikern. Diane gesteht ihm, dass sie inzwischen mit Frasier zusammen ist.

programme.title: Cheers: Der falsche Name zur falschen Zeit
programme.sub-title: Der falsche Name zur falschen Zeit
programme.desc: Frasier, Dianes neuer Freund, bittet Sam um eine Gespräch unter Männern. Etwas Schreckliches ist geschehen: Im Bett mit Frasier hat Diane ausgerechnet im schönsten Augenblick Sams Namen gerufen.

programme.title: Cheers: Cliffs erstes Rendezvous
programme.desc: Stammgast Cliff hat Schwierigkeiten mit den Frauen: Er ist sehr schüchtern. Bei einem Maskenball lernt er endlich eine Dame kennen. Die beiden verabreden sich für den nächsten Tag, um zu erfahren, wie sie ohne Masken aussehen.

programme.title: Cheers: Ein Schuß in die Backe
programme.desc: Sam hat mit einer seiner zahlreichen Freundinnen Schluss gemacht. Der Grund: Sie ist verheiratet. Kurz darauf taucht ihr Ehemann auf und bedroht Sam mit einer Waffe. Am nächsten Tag kommt dieser mit einer seltsamen Verletzung ins Cheers.

programme.title: Cheers: Liebesglück und zwei Millionen – Teil 1
programme.desc: Der Coach trifft im Cheers eine Frau. Für ihn ist es Liebe auf den ersten Blick. Er macht ihr prompt einen Heiratsantrag – und erhält ein unerwartetes Ja. Coach ist völlig aus dem Häuschen. Doch die Sache hat einen Haken.

programme.title: Cheers: Liebesglück und zwei Millionen – Teil 2
programme.desc: Irene hat unerwartet zwei Millionen Dollar in der Lotterie gewonnen. Der Gewinn steigt ihr zu Kopf, und sie verabschiedet sich von Coach. Der will nicht wahrhaben, dass sie ihn verlässt. Vergeblich wartet er am Tag der Hochzeit auf die Braut.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Drohung der Drachen
programme.desc: Norm hat Geburtstag. Er verletzt sich lebensgefährlich an einem Korken. Diane lernt endlich die Mutter von Frasier kennen. Die ist zunächst sehr freundlich. Dann aber rät sie Diane, die Finger von Frasier zu lassen. Andernfalls werde sie Diane erschießen.

programme.title: Cheers: Der betörende Widerling

programme.title: Cheers: Allergisch gegen wen?

programme.title: Cheers: Südseeträume

programme.title: Cheers: Die Sache mit Amanda

programme.title: Cheers: Doktor Ludlows große Liebe

programme.title: Cheers: Auf zur Schnepfenjagd!

programme.title: Cheers: Schlechte Verlierer

programme.title: Cheers: Lehrerins Liebling

programme.title: Cheers: Der Postraub von Boston

programme.title: Cheers: Sams künftige Ex-Frau

programme.title: Šifra mistra Leonarda
programme.desc: Světový bestseller Dana Browna s názvem Šifra mistra Leonarda přichází ve filmové podobě režiséra Rona Howarda. Symbololog Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) je zapleten do záhadné a bizarní vraždy. Po svém boku má vnučku oběti a kryptoložku Sophii Neveuovou (Audrey Tautouová), která společně s Robertem objeví stopy obsažené v Da Vinciho obrazech. Ve snaze rozklíčovat celou pravdu se Robert se Sophií vydají z Paříže do Londýna a cestou potkají nejen spojence, ale i darebáky jako jsou Sir Leigh Teabing (Ian McKellen) a Silas (Paul Bettany). Ať už je kroky zavedou kamkoli, tajemství, které má vyplout na povrch, by mohlo otřást základy křesťanství.

programme.title: Transformers 3
programme.desc: Autoboti zjistí, že na Měsíci je ukryté speciální vesmírné plavidlo a spolu s Deceptikony se předhánějí, kdo ho získá. To ještě netuší, že plavidlo skrývá tajemství, které by mohlo zvrátit výsledky rozhodující bitvy Transformers. Záhadná událost z minulosti planety Země možná znovu vyvolá válku. Ovšem válku takového měřítka, že Transformers nebudou stačit síly, aby planetu zachránili. Když astronauti z Apolla 11 objeví zbytky Sentinel Prime na povrchu zemské přirozené družice, přivezou ho zpět na Zemi. Jenže Sentinel nebyl jediným cizím objektem na Měsíci. Spolu s ním přicestoval i nepřátelský Sam Witwicky! Autoboti budou muset bojovat s temnotou a ubránit náš svět před nejděsivějším zlem Deceptikonů.

programme.title: Zkus mě rozesmát
programme.desc: Danny (Adam Sandler) je úspěšný plastický chirurg, který má opravdu nekonvenční sváděcí taktiky: předstírá, že je nešťastně ženatý. Když však potká ženu svých snů (Brooklyn Decker) svůj osvědčený příběh o nevydařeném manželství nechá u ledu a raději je sám sebou. Jenže jeho vyvolená brzy objeví jeho falešný snubní prstýnek. Danny se bojí jí říci trapnou pravdu, a tak své drahé raději namluví, že se rozvádí. Jenže ta se chce s jeho ženou setkat. A tak Dannymu nezbývá nic jiného, než požádat svou asistentku Katherine (Jennifer Aniston) o pomoc. Jenže jedna lež vede ke druhé, celá situace se pěkně zamotá a nakonec vše skončí výletem na Havaj, který jim zcela změní život.

programme.title: Ave, Caesar!
programme.desc: Oscaroví filmoví tvůrci Joel a Ethan Coenovi (Tahle země není pro starý, Opravdová kuráž, Fargo) napsali a natočili film AVE, CAESAR!. Příběh nás zavede na natáčení typického hollywoodského velkofilmu z padesátých let minulého století Ave Caesar!. Šéf studia Eddie Mannix (Josh Brolin) investoval astronomické částky do výpravy, kulis a herců, ale superhvězda Baird Whitlock (George Clooney) byla během natáčení unesena.

programme.title: Hon na lišku
programme.desc: Snímek FOXCATCHER, inspirovaný skutečnými událostmi, vypráví příběh olympijského vítěze v zápase Marka Schultze (Channing Tatum). Ten spatří příležitost vykročit ze stínu svého slavného staršího bratra Davea (Mark Ruffalo) a života v chudobě poté, co se mu dostane pozvání od bohatého dědice Johna du Ponta (Steve Carell), aby se nastěhoval do jeho okázalého sídla, kde má sestavit a trénovat zápasnický tým pro olympiádu v Soulu v roce 1988. Du Pont, jenž se zoufale snaží získat respekt své odmítavé matky (Vanessa Redgraveová), se staví do pozice hlavního trenéra celého týmu. Du Pontova nevypočitatelná povaha a psychologické hrátky ale začínají velmi výrazně nahlodávat Markovo již tak nejisté sebevědomí a negativně ovlivňovat výkony, které je schopen na žíněnce podávat. Když začne du Pont upřednostňovat jeho bratra Davea - který má autoritu i sebevědomí, jež Mark i du Pont postrádají - je celé trio na cestě vstříc tragédii, kterou nikdo nedokázal předvídat.

programme.title: Užitečný duch
programme.desc: Nat, čerstvě zemřelá žena, se vrací jako duch v těle vysavače, aby uklízela domácnost a bránila rodinu před zákeřnými entitami.

programme.title: Užitečný duch

programme.title: Zpráva
programme.desc: Po 11. září začala CIA používat vůči lidem podezřelým z terorismu extrémně brutální vyšetřovací metody. Stačilo pouhé podezření. Vedlo to postupně k několika skandálům a také k vyšetřování programu na zadržování a vyslýchání. Hlavní hrdina amerického dramatu, senátor Daniel Jones (Adam Driver), je skutečnou postavou - snímek sleduje jeho pečlivou analýzu dostupných důkazů ''zdokonalených technik'', které se ukázaly být nemorální i neúčinné. Když se Jones rozhodne se senátním vyšetřovacím výborem zveřejnit výsledky svého vyšetřování, CIA a Bílý dům se tomu snaží zabránit.

programme.title: Tajemství rodiny Stokerů
programme.desc: Po smrti otce se k osmnáctileté Indii a její matce nastěhuje strýc, o kterém neměla tušení. India od začátku cítí, že tento záhadný člověk má postranní úmysly, brzy je jím ale úplně okouzlena. Po tragické smrti otce v den jejích osmnáctých narozenin se India Stoker seznamuje s Charliem, charismatickým strýcem, o jehož existenci až dosud neměla ponětí. Když se Charlie nastěhuje k Indii a její labilní matce, obě jsou okouzleny jeho šarmem a klidem. Brzy je ale jasné, že Charlieův příjezd nebyl náhodný, a že jeho šokující tajemství z minulosti mohou zásadně ovlivnit nebo dokonce úplně zničit Indiinu budoucnost.

programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: V energickém akčním filmu se Rocky utkává se svým dosud nejsilnějším protivníkem - krutým svalovcem jménem Clubber Lang (Mr. T). V možná nejnapínavějším a nejpoutavějším dílu celé série jde Rocky od jednoho vítězství ke druhému, podepisuje lukrativní smlouvy a stává se slavným po celém světě. Když ale "italský hřebec" utrpí potupnou porážku od Clubbera Langa, zdá se, že pomalu ztrácí své výsadní postavení. S pomocí odvěkého rivala Apolla Creeda (Carl Weathers) se Rocky snaží znovu získat bojového ducha, aby se s Langem mohl utkat ve vyčerpávající odvetě o světového šampiona v těžké váze.

programme.title: Good bye, Lenin!
programme.desc: Říjen roku 1989 nebyl právě nejvhodnější čas pro upadnutí do kómatu, tedy aspoň pro občany Východního Německa. A přesně to se stalo Alexově matce, nadšené zastánkyni socialismu. Když se o osm měsíců později probudí, Alex stojí před velkým problémem. Její srdce je tak slabé, že by ji mohl zabít sebemenší šok. A co by Alexovu matku mohlo šokovat víc, než pád Berlínské zdi a konečné vítězství kapitalismu v jejím milovaném Východním Německu? Aby ji Alex zachránil, udělá z jejich společného bytu ostrůvek minulosti, jakési muzeum socialistické éry, kde si bude jeho matka připoutaná na lůžko užívat milosrdné nevědomosti a žít v přesvědčení, že se nic nezměnilo. Alexovi jeho plán nějakou dobu vychází, ovšem jen do té doby, než se matka začne cítit líp a odhodlá se znovu postavit na vlastní nohy.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un guardia de seguridad desapareció de su puesto sin dejar rastro. Sus restos fueron encontrados un año después en un campamento lejano.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2004, Mary Ann Clibbery fue brutalmente asesinada en su negocio de Illinois. Los investigadores tuvieron que determinar si esto fue un robo que salió mal o un asesinato premeditado.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Bruce Miller fue asesinado a tiros en la oficina del negocio de depósito de chatarra que poseía. La escena del crimen estaba casi inmaculada.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un vecino vio cómo un hombre apuñalaba a su esposa, la empujaba a la piscina y le metía la cabeza bajo el agua.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Edward Post preparó un baño para su esposa antes de salir a correr. Regresó y la encontró sin respirar. Murió antes de que llegara la ambulancia. La policía consideró su muerte como accidental hasta que surgió un motivo.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Los excursionistas cerca de Anchorage, Alaska, descubrieron un cuerpo envuelto en sábanas con bordes de costura naranja.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En algún momento durante una fiesta de Navidad en el vecindario, Melissa Brannen, de cinco años, desapareció. Los investigadores recurrieron a la ciencia forense para ayudarlos a ver lo que se perdieron los testigos.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.sub-title: Hasta que La Muerte Nos Separe
programme.desc: Los doctores del hospital no pudieron determinar la causa de las alucinaciones y el intenso dolor de Bobby Curley. Lo trataron como un trastorno neurológico pero su estado se deterioró. Él estaba siendo envenenado.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando un miembro adinerado de la sociedad muere después de caer de las escaleras, los testimonios de los testigos contradicen la evidencia.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El fuego envuelve la casa donde Lori Keidel y sus hermanos se quedaron solos mientras su padre iba a la lavandería. Años después de la desaparición de su madre, Lori le dice a la policía que fue testigo de la muerte de su madre.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El examinador médico clasificó la muerte como un accidente, pero los detectives que investigaron el caso declararon que la evidencia en la escena indicaba lo contrario.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Una pastilla amarga para tragar
programme.desc: Se cuenta la historia de la bombero Michelle Baker. Después de conocer al Dr. Maynard Muntzing, quedó embarazada de él. Después de esta noticia, ella se enfermaba siempre que estaban juntos.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando un joven bombero murió de lo que parecía ser una enfermedad cardíaca grave pero no diagnosticada, su familia y amigos quedaron devastados, pero no tenían pruebas de algún juego sucio.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2004, Rebecca Barney y su futuro exmarido Fred fueron hallados muertos a tiros en su casa de Tulsa, Oklahoma, la cual había sido incendiada.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1998, una actuación de asesinato misterioso en Maryland se convierte en una verdadera novela policíaca cuando se descubre el cuerpo gravemente quemado de Stephen Hricko en su habitación de hotel.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Voto de silencio
programme.desc: Una mirada al caso contra Jack Reeves. Unos amigos informaron que su novia por correo había desaparecido. La policía centró sus sospechas en Reeves y, mientras buscaba pistas, descubrió información que lo vinculaba con la muerte de dos ex esposas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En el 2000, cuando la adolescente Tara Munsey desapareció al salir de su trabajo en un restaurante de Virginia, no se sabe si se escapó o si fue víctima de un juego sucio.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Se encuentra a Nancy Newman y a sus dos hijas que fueron brutalmente asesinadas. La escena del crimen no tiene escasez de pruebas, pero los investigadores no pueden encontrar un vínculo concluyente con su principal sospechoso.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.sub-title: Condena por huella de palma de mano
programme.desc: Una investigación sobre un asesinato se ve favorecida por un requisito legal de que los bares tengan cámaras de video instaladas en las instalaciones. Video, cabello y sangre conducen al asesino.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1996, Gayle Isleib, de 54 años, fue emboscada en su camino de entrada de Manchester, Connecticut, y asesinada a tiros. Ahora la policía debe determinar si el amor se convirtió en obsesión... y en un motivo de asesinato.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Sometimes, when a man and a woman unite, a terrible urge for destruction can awaken in them both. Happy couples become deadly teams, intent on one goal: murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women are more often prey than predators, but the exceptions are deadly women indeed. In this episode, we’ll discover what drove these deadly women to prey on the unsuspecting.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While their sisters chose a life of sensible, suburban motherhood, these deadly women chose a life of crime. They lived with the thrills, the danger and the deadly consequences of being outlaws.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Married to Murder
programme.desc: To the outside world, their marriages seemed happy. But behind closed doors, there was no domestic bliss. These women wanted out, but getting a divorce wasn’t their preferred option.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: No one doubts a woman’s capacity to love, but sometimes lust can turn lethal. In the ultimate fatal attraction, "Deadly Women" looks at cases of murder driven by obsessive love.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Judi Buenoano secretly murdered lovers to claim on insurance policies whilst nurse Genene Jones secretly killed at least 46 infants left in her care between 1980 and 1982.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women never get their hands dirty: no blood touched them because they manipulate others to kill for them...but they didn't get away.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Under His Control
programme.desc: These are love stories with bleak, bloody endings. Blinded by desire, obsessed and malleable, some women fall into lethal relationships with dangerous, controlling men.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Blood ties are strong ties, sometimes strong enough to pull a person into a murderous conspiracy. When a family member wields his or her power, the result can be death.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Obsession
programme.desc: Deciphering what causes minds to corkscrew out of control is the complex work of the criminal profiler. Obsessions can take many forms: beauty, devotion, ego and power.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love Gone Wrong
programme.desc: Love can be beautiful, love can be blind and love can be deadly. Desire and jealousy are powerful forces driving women to dark and horrifying places in their minds.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Teen Killers
programme.desc: They were too young to drink or vote but they were not too young to commit the most brutal of crimes. Some were driven by pure curiosity: how would it feel to take a life?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Crimes of revenge are usually single acts of passion. A brew of hatred and restitution boils over in a manic moment of fury. Once caught, revenge killers usually display remorse and atonement.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The path towards revenge can sometimes lead to murder. It can be quick, fiery and violent. It can also be a dish served cold, the product of a calm, calculated plot.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Strip Search
programme.desc: When a stripper goes on the lam, Dog has to bring her in. It's a tough job but somebody has to do it. Thankfully for the team, Lady Luck is presiding over the posse tonight.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Secret Places
programme.desc: When Leland learns that one of his clients with a reputation for stealing has lost her co-signer and could be ready to run, Dog and the crew hop a plane to the Big Island.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Wrong Turn
programme.desc: Dog's target today seems to have a taste for drugs and a record of reckless driving. The hunt has deep emotional resonance for the team because today is the anniversary of the fatal car accident of Dog's daughter Barbara Katie.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Easy Rider
programme.desc: What looks like a routine pick-up turns into a complicated case of betrayal, deceit, as well as quality nail care as Dog and company track down a fugitive alleged to be an abusive boyfriend with one too many friends in his close knit community.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Call Waiting
programme.desc: Dog's target for today has been in trouble with the law since he was a juvenile. And he seems willing to use any trick in the system to avoid capture by Dog. In this match of wits, will Dog prevail?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Kid Stuff
programme.desc: A fugitive from justice is on the lam and it's Dog's job to find him. When they hit the last known address they discover he already has pulled up stakes and left no forwarding address. The posse's one hope is to locate his girlfriend.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Easy Does It
programme.desc: There is a running joke in the posse that every time Bobby Brown asks them for help with a fugitive, he always promises them it's "an easy one," but the hunts end up being epic searches.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Ghost Rider
programme.desc: Dog believes in safety first, and today's hunt puts this philosophy to the test. The fugitive's problem with anger management increases the dangers of their already risky line of work. Dog warns the crew to be ready for anything as they head out.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Back in the Hood
programme.desc: Today, Dog's bounty is about to take him on a trip down memory lane and test his investigative chops. With each lead propelling him closer and closer to his childhood haunts, Dog uses old-fashioned detective skills to track his prey.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: One for the Road
programme.desc: Dog is a big-hearted guy. He's helping Mary Ellen, his friend and fellow bondsman, on a dangerous night hunt for a fugitive she is now regretting bailing out. He's also giving his nephew Justin a second chance to rejoin the team.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bait and Switch
programme.desc: Things are seldom what they seem in the world of bounty hunting. When the fugitive's girlfriend offers to help Dog trap this dangerous felon, Dog knows that someone is being deceived. The only question is, whom?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: True Identity
programme.desc: Dog knows that looks can be deceiving. The fugitive is pretty, petite, and trouble. She stands accused of settling an argument with the help of a box cutter. What Dog does not anticipate is how deceptive this femme fatale can truly be!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: What do you do when you have a fugitive you not only want to find, but believe can be helped back onto the straight and narrow? If you're Mary Ellen you call your good friend Dog.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Match Point
programme.desc: Duty calls and the Chapmans are off on a hunt. The team chases a fugitive who has disappeared into a world of "no known addresses."

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Menehune Mischief
programme.desc: When Beth returns to the compound on the Big Island she finds a damaged SUV and two possible culprits - Dog or Justin. Pressed by Beth, Dog offers a third option. The perpetrators are Hawaii's mythical mischief makers - the Menehune!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mister Mom
programme.desc: It's been quite a while since Tim Chapman put down his mace can and bulletproof vest to care for his growing family. When his old friend Dog calls asking for help tracking an elusive felon, Tim jumps into action.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bait & Snitch
programme.desc: With the aid of the runner's girlfriend the posse heads out to bring a client with a checked past in. Little does the team suspect that before the end of the day Dog will be helping to mend a family torn apart by violence.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Scared Straight
programme.desc: Dog tracks a fugitive who is on the run from the law for the first time. Reading the file Dog knows the young man's life is at the crossroads. Will he be able to track down this wanna-be-gangsta in time to convince him to make the right choice?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: All My Children
programme.desc: For a guy who started life as a free spirited outlaw-biker Dog has certainly turned into a family man. His children touch everything he does today, from searching for the perfect gift for his daughter Cecily's birthday to hunting a fugitive.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: The hunt for an elusive and clever criminal takes Dog through the world of a bantam fighting cock, a pregnant daughter, and a jungle safe house go together. And don't forget the mopeds as well as a group of hostile squatters on government land!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bounty Baby
programme.desc: What's a father to do? When the cops ask Dog for help tracking down a renegade teen with a history of running hard, Baby Lyssa, eight months pregnant and counting, insists on joining the hunt. Can Dog keep his daughter safe and catch his man?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rain Check

programme.title: Robert Mac
programme.desc: Robert's award-winning comedy is smart, subtle, and silly. Not too smart and not too subtle, but occasionally a bit more silly than youíd expect. And always clean. Robert is a regular at some of the finest comedy clubs around the country. Winner of "Comedy Centralís Laugh Riots." Finalist at "Billy Crystalís Mr. Saturday Night Contest", "San Francisco International Comedy Competition", "Boston Comedy Festival", "Jerry Lewis MDA Telethon Talent Search."

programme.title: Seth Tippetts
programme.desc: Get to know Seth from the chest down. He's big, he's tall, but most of all he's hilarious. Check out this Utah-raised, clean, and semi-professional comedian today!

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: Benny lives in Brooklyn where he fiddles around with old Land Rovers when he is supposed to be helping his wife run her natural skincare business. He has a dog named Grits and two cats who prefer that he not share their personal information in this bio.

programme.title: Reno Collier
programme.desc: Reno's journey began at the Punchline Comedy Club in Atlanta, GA where he tended bar to supplement his day job. He found himself on stage during the weekly open mic night. His unique outlook on life - mixed with a six-pack, was instantly popular.

programme.title: Rex Havens
programme.desc: Rex has been delighting comedy audiences for 20 years, in world-famous comedy clubs like The Improv, Catch-A-Rising Star, Funny Bones and Zanies, on television for Showtime, Comedy Central and Comic Relief, on radio with Bob & Tom and NPR, cruise ships worldwide, and corporate clients including GM, American Express, Texaco, 3M, Coca-Cola, IBM, Toshiba, Lowe's, Johnson & Johnson, Ameritech, Proctor & Gamble, State Farm, Quaker Oats, Verizon and the IRS (“Working for the IRS is the only sure way to get money from them.”), and numerous non-profit and charitable organizations, such as St. Jude's and the Make-A-Wish Foundation. A former college professor who made the unusual transition to the standup comedy stage in the '80's, Rex has always believed that laughter is the best defense against a confusing and challenging world. Rex's take on marriage and family has propelled him to performances in all 50 states and around the world, including London, Hong Kong, Amsterdam, Bermuda, Montreal, Barcelona, Copenhagen, Aruba, Rome and Cannes.

programme.title: Cleto Rodriguez
programme.desc: Rodriguez connects with audiences by relating everyday life experiences. Anything and everything is fair game, from marriage mishaps to the challenges of dieting. His comedy is high-energy, observational and hilarious with a brilliant Latino twist.

programme.title: Arvin Mitchell
programme.desc: With an array of impressions, stories, gestures and faces, Arvin's memorable performance is sure to please. As the former co-host of BET's Club Comic View, Arvin has been featured on Kevin Heart's “One Mic Stand”, Tony Rocks “The Funny Spot” as well as entertaining our troops abroad. Nominated as one of NBC's Stand Up for Diversity top comics Arvin continues to tour colleges, clubs, cruise ships & churches.

programme.title: XTERRA Adventures
programme.desc: S01E08 XTERRA is the world's premier off-road multisport event. An extreme competition, the XTERRA format combines swimming with mountain biking and trail running. It has been described as one part triathlon, one part mountain bike race, and one part "survival of the fittest". The typical distances are a 1.5k swim, 30k mountain bike, and 10k trail run.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E07 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race - 2019
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense 'flash stage', featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km "finisher" stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo's unforgettable single-track...

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race - 2019
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense 'flash stage', featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km "finisher" stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo's unforgettable single-track...

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E07 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.desc: Mithilfe von Sam eröffnet Gibby im Keller der Schule ein geheimes Restaurant. Unterdessen designt Spencer einen Sicherheitsroboter fürs Loft. Doch der Roboter spielt plötzlich verrückt!

programme.title: iCarly: April, April ...
programme.desc: Es ist der 1. April! Carly und Spencer sollen aus ihrer Wohnung zwangsgeräumt werden, also teilen die Freunde ihre gemeinsamen Erlebnisse in der Wohnung. Doch wir erinnern uns etwas anders.

programme.title: iCarly: Plötzlich Verkäuferin
programme.desc: Freddies neuer Traumjob im Pear Store wird zum Albtraum sobald Sam auch angeheuert wird. Unterdessen will Carly, dass einer ihrer Kollegen sie nach einem Date fragt und Spencer muss bei der Freiwilligen Feuerwehr ehrenamtlich arbeiten.

programme.title: iCarly: Happy Hälft-o-ween!
programme.desc: Die iCarly-Gang schmeißt eine 'Hälft-o-ween' Party, weil Halloween so toll ist, dass es am besten zweimal im Jahr gefeiert werden sollte! Doch die Party gerät außer Kontrolle als ein kostümierter Gast Carly und ihren Freunden einen Streich spielt.

programme.title: iCarly: Chip, Chuck & Spencer
programme.desc: Gibbys neues Spielzeug geht kaputt, doch Freddie repariert es ihm und legt noch einen oben drauf. Spencer versucht einem rachsüchtigen Kind mit allen Mitteln das Handwerk zu legen.

programme.title: iCarly: Hausverbot
programme.desc: Carly verbietet T-Bo einen Fuß in die Wohnung zu setzen. Er revanchiert sich, indem er sie aus dem Groovy Smoothie verbannt. Freddie und Gibby entdecken die Vorzüge einer Band anzugehören. Doch Pflichten bringt es auch mit sich.

programme.title: iCarly: Ausflug nach Vegas
programme.desc: Als Sam erfährt, dass ihre Mutter in Las Vegas im Gefängnis sitzt, packt die Truppe ihre wertvollsten Sachen ein und verpfändet sie, um Geld für die Kaution aufzutreiben. Gastdarsteller: die Besetzung der History-Channel-Serie 'Die Drei vom Pfandhaus'.

programme.title: iCarly: Brave Mädchen, böse Mädchen
programme.desc: Sams Freundin wird aus dem Jugendgefängnis entlassen, und Sam rät allen, sich von ihr fernzuhalten. Doch Carly hört nicht auf sie und traut sich zu viel zu. Im Loft findet Spencer eine Nachtsichtbrille.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibby schockiert Amerika – Teil 1
programme.desc: Talkshow-Legende Jimmy Fallon lädt die Crew von iCarly ein, live in seiner Show in New York zu performen. Doch live auf Sendung schockiert Gibby durch ein Hosen-Missgeschick die ganze Welt und bringt beide Shows in große Schwierigkeiten.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibby schockiert Amerika – Teil 2
programme.desc: Talkshow-Legende Jimmy Fallon lädt die Crew von iCarly ein, live in seiner Show in New York zu performen. Doch live auf Sendung schockiert Gibby durch ein Hosen-Missgeschick die ganze Welt und bringt beide Shows in große Schwierigkeiten.

programme.title: iCarly: Freunde für Spencer
programme.desc: Die Truppe zieht los, um für Spencer Freunde in seinem Alter zu suchen. Sie finden schließlich ein paar vielversprechende Kandidaten. Aber werden sie auch wirklich zu Freunden?

programme.title: iCarly: Ciao Carly – Teil 1
programme.desc: Als Spencer an einem für Carly wichtigen Abend Fieber bekommt, versucht er, seine Krankheit vor ihr zu verstecken. Sam restauriert ein Motorrad, und Freddie bekommt ein peinliches neues Handy.

programme.title: iCarly: Ciao Carly – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly hat sich gerade damit abgefunden, dass sie nicht zum Ball gehen wird, als ihr Vater plötzlich auftaucht, um mit ihr hinzugehen. Carlys Abend nimmt eine weitere unerwartete Wendung, als ihr Vater ihr eine lebensverändernde Frage stellt.

programme.title: iCarly: Miss Briggs sagt 'No!'
programme.desc: Mitgefangen, mitgehangen: Carly muss ausbaden, dass sich ihre beste Freundin und Banknachbarin Sam in der Schule mal wieder einen Streich erlaubt hat.

programme.title: iCarly: Eine leuchtende Idee
programme.desc: Carly hat die Idee, einen Wettstreit zu veranstalten und die Zuschauer online über den Sieger abstimmen zu lassen. Es geht darum, welches Team die beste Idee hat, wie man mehr Zuschauer für iCarly gewinnen kann.

programme.title: iCarly: Ein Schotte kommt selten allein
programme.desc: Carly und Co. fordern ihre treue Fangemeinde auf, ihre eigenen Tanz-Videoclips aufzunehmen und einzusenden. Die Reaktion ist überwältigend: In kürzester Zeit trudeln über 3.000 Videos ein – die natürlich alle gesichtet werden müssen.

programme.title: iCarly: Ein liebes Lied
programme.desc: Carly hat sich in einen Jungen aus der Schule verliebt. Weil sie ihn mag, lädt sie ihn dazu ein, in ihrer Webshow zu singen und Gitarre zu spielen. Leider merkt sie zu spät, welch ein schlechter Sänger Jake wirklich ist.

programme.title: iCarly: Das Großvaterdebakel
programme.desc: Carly und Spencer bekommen überraschend Besuch von ihrem Großvater. Er ist sehr besorgt darüber, dass Spencer nicht verantwortungsbewusst genug ist, um sich weiter um Carly zu kümmern. Carly und ihre Freunde versuchen das Gegenteil zu beweisen.

programme.title: iCarly: Nevel Supernerd
programme.desc: Carly und Co. bemühen sich darum, eine positive Kritik bei Nevelocity zu bekommen, einer Webseite, die über fünf Millionen Besucher pro Tag zu verzeichnet. Als sich Carly mit Nevel trifft, findet sie heraus, was für ein nerviger Junge er ist.

programme.title: iCarly: Absolut halloweenös!
programme.desc: Carly und Co. nehmen eine Show in einem alten Apartment auf, in dem es angeblich spukt. Als merkwürdige Dinge passieren, befürchten die Freunde, dass die Behauptungen über die Geisterwohnung wahr sein könnten.

programme.title: iCarly: Miss Briggs privat
programme.desc: Carly & Co. betätigen sich als Spione: Sie wollen herausfinden, was ihre Lehrer so in ihrer Freizeit tun - und die nichts ahnenden Pädagogen werden dabei für die iCarly-Website gefilmt!

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "Sri Lanka: Legends of Ceylon"
programme.desc: Jonathan tracks ancient myths across Sri Lanka, unearthing sobering tsunami stories, hidden lighthouses, and unique local beverages.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "Sri Lanka: Footsteps of Ravana"
programme.desc: Jonathan hunts for mythological sites with local monks before embedding with the Vedda people, the island's original indigenous inhabitants.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "Taiwan: Bunkers and Bubble Tea"
programme.desc: Jonathan explores urban farms, decodes bubble tea origins, and hunts for the truth behind Taiwan's vast network of hidden military bunkers.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Brazil’s Pantanal"
programme.desc: There may be no place on earth so rich in wildlife as Brazil’s Pantanal. In this Quest, Bill is going to track some of the rainforest creatures he’s always wanted to see.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Cultural Rwanda"
programme.desc: They say time heals all wounds, but can it heal the most horrific of all—genocide. On this Quest, Bill returns to Rwanda to see the post-war healing happening in this small, but globally significant country.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Australia Top to Bottom"
programme.desc: Australia is a giant country with diverse ecosystems that make it one of the most interesting in the world. This episode of Travel Quest explores the north and far south of this country…the world’s biggest “island”.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Kushtia, Bangladesh"
programme.desc: The brothers traverse the country’s interconnecting network of waterways by ferryboat. From shrimp baron, to peasant fishermen, lofty temple ruins to anonymous chai wallahs, they make their way to Kushtia, home to the shrine of Guru Lalone Shaw.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Kingdom of Mustang, Nepal"
programme.desc: Securing special visas, the brothers get 10 ponies and 6 porters and undertake a stunning, but difficult 13-day pony trek over the Himalayas to the valley of Mustang where they will try to have a sitting with the king.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Iceberg Alley, Newfoundland, Canada"
programme.desc: Flying a bush plane to the far-reaching tip of the ‘Rock’, the brothers are back in the rugged, isolated island where they were born. Via kayak, the brothers paddle from fishing port to fishing port before reaching their ultimate destination.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S6 - "Te Urewera"
programme.desc: Piri and ex Warrior Wairangi Koopu are deep in Te Urewera. Hosted by Waimana’s local all female hunting group the “Wahine Slayaz”, they hunt Deer, gather Oysters and make Rongoā with Koro Hori Hillman.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S6 - "Taupō"
programme.desc: Piri and ex Crusader Tu Umaga-Marshall are in Taupō, on the lake targeting Trout, having a run around with the Taupō Juniors Touch Team and learning some Taupō Hītori from Piri’s high school mate Awhina Eru.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S6 - "Whakatū"
programme.desc: Piri and ex Warrior Wairangi Koopu are down in Whakatū (Nelson). They’re hosted by Cyril Collier targeting Snapper, put to the test by Raniera Petersen with a Mau Rakau lesson and visit the Anatoki Salmon Farm.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Hawaii"
programme.desc: Chris travels to Hawaii’s Big Island, hikes to the heart of a volcano and takes a night dive that brings him face to face with dozens of giant manta rays.

वाइट पेपर
ஒயிட் பேப்பர்
వైట్ పేపర్
व्हाईट पेपर
programme.desc: The host presents information about the social, economic and political issues of the day and provides updates on current events.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता दिन के सामाजिक, आर्थिक और राजनीतिक मुद्दों के बारे में जानकारी प्रस्तुत करते हुए और वर्तमान घटनाक्रमों पर ताजा जानकारी प्रदान करते हैं।
அன்றைய சமூக, பொருளாதார மற்றும் அரசியல் பிரச்சினைகள் பற்றிய தகவல்கள் மற்றும் தற்போதைய நிகழ்வுகள் குறித்த புதுப்பிப்புகள்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఈనాటి సామాజిక, ఆర్థిక, రాజకీయ సమస్యల గురించి సమాచారాన్ని అందిస్తారు, ప్రస్తుత సంఘటనలపై విశేషాలను అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: Loyalty and Larceny
programme.desc: Broke couple Deon and Tiff accidentally steal a package of premium weed meant for a local dealer working under Queen Pin. Forced to become rookie dealers in Dallas to pay off their debt, they fumble their way through the drug game while trying to survive the ruthless Queen Pin and a vengeful rival, C-Mo. When they uncover a deeper betrayal, they must fight for their lives and a shot at running their own LA empire.

programme.title: Father Knows Best
programme.desc: Zoe Miles, raised by a controlling father who introduces her to a life of crime, grapples with the lingering trauma of her mother's death. Yearning to embrace the spiritual life she shared with her grandmother, Zoe finds herself trapped in a cycle of violence, forced to rob drug dealers after witnessing a terrifying crime. Desperate to escape this destructive path, she struggles against her father's suffocating control, fearing the loss of his approval and the validation she desperately seeks.

programme.title: Contusion
programme.desc: Terry and his grandmother enjoy a life of peace and harmony, until one night when a group of thieves invade their home. As he navigates from the aftermath, he must confront whether justice will prevail or whether darkness will consume everything he holds dear.

programme.title: My Husband's Mistress
programme.desc: Behind the glamorous facade of the aviation industry, a dirty betrayal unfolds. A devoted wife's world is shattered when she discovers her husband's affair with her best friend. As the truth unravels, a battle for love, revenge, and survival ensues.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: Karmen, a successful businesswoman is secure and thriving in every part of her life, except for love. She downloads a dating app and seems to have found Mr. Right in Jermaine, but her best friends warn her that he might be a scammer. As Karmen falls deeper, she slowly falls victim to a network of lies and deceit, that could cost her life.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: Baddies Revenge
programme.desc: After discovering her NFL-star boyfriend proposed to another woman live on television, Sierra turns her heartbreak turns into rage. She brings in her closest friends who have suffered betrayals of their own and begin to target the men that destroyed them emotionally.

programme.title: Crash Out
programme.desc: An up-and-coming podcast starts to take off, they land an exclusive interview with a controversial wellness guru. But when an on-air confrontation begins to escalate, the effects of his own product begin to take over with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Hated By Many Loved By None
programme.desc: After a violent robbery and a shocking betrayal from her incarcerated husband, Jahzara is forced to fend for herself in a world she was never meant to lead. With her closest friends, Tomeka and Honey, by her side, she steps into the drug game, determined to rebuild her life. But as money, power, and new connections take over, loyalty quickly turns into betrayal.

programme.title: Rich Intent
programme.desc: 16-year-old Quana yearns to go to her very first concert. When she gets the opportunity to see her favorite artist, her dreams quickly spiral into a horrific nightmare of imprisonment and shady deals.

programme.title: Restraining Order
programme.desc: A married woman of 10 years, longs for a life of luxury and opulence. An old flame begins to catch her eye as a means to fulfill that dream, at the cost of her jealous husband. He begins to cause a storm of terror, where she fears for her safety.

programme.title: The Queens Court
programme.desc: The Queens Court is an underground, all female organization that rules on all criminal activity in the city. Nothing is done without the queens courts verdict first, and those who fail to comply will be dealt with, by any means necessary.

programme.title: The Perfect Wife
programme.desc: A young freelance photographer in Houston meets a beautiful determined teacher from Atlanta. His best friend tries to warn him about her. There is something a little strange about Claudia. Q loves her dearly but she may not be The Perfect Wife.

programme.title: The Perfect Wife 2
programme.desc: The Styles Girls relocate to a new state to start over after the loss of the only place they knew. Unbeknownst to them, the secrets they left behind surface within the walls of their new residence.

programme.title: The Only Child
programme.desc: Twelve-year old Chris has a wonderful and thriving childhood with her loving family. When her mother dies tragically in a car accident, she begins to go down a dark spiral. When Chris’ father starts seeing another woman, she begins a sinister plan, as no woman will ever replace her mother.

programme.title: Legends of the Highway
programme.desc: Follow the true story of the Florida Highwaymen, 26 self-taught African American artists who forged their own path to success in the segregated 1950’s and 60’s. Their stories are guided by the mentorship of renowned landscape painters A.E. Backus, Alfred Hair, and Harold Newton. Their troupe captured Florida’s breathtaking landscapes and sold their paintings along state highways, circumventing the traditional art world that excluded them.

programme.title: Waiting to Process
programme.desc: Four friends—DeShea, Liz, Raven, and Devine—are bound by sisterhood but challenged by the men in their lives. DeShea dates a man with ties to her family, Liz's boyfriend is immature, Raven juggles multiple men, and Devine's husband has a mistress who becomes a deadly threat. As secrets and betrayals test their loyalties, the women must decide if their friendship can survive the chaos.

programme.title: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Blake, a man on the verge of marriage who becomes ensnared in a dangerous game of deception and revenge orchestrated by his vengeful ex, London. As their past resurfaces, he is forced to confront hidden secrets and navigate London's sinister manipulations, leading to explosive confrontations and heart-pounding suspense.

programme.title: The Other Sister
programme.desc: After ending her relationship to focus on her future, a driven young woman invites her troubled sister to move in for a fresh start. But as boundaries begin to blur, jealousy turns into obsession, and trust quickly unravels. When secrets come to light, she must confront a chilling truth. Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF
programme.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: Deadly Surrogate
programme.desc: When a young married couple suffer the pain of infertility, they look to the path of surrogacy and come upon Alana as a potential candidate. As the three become intertwined, tensions begin to unravel and threaten to consume them.

programme.title: Blind Tiez
programme.desc: Naire is on the up and up as he’s recently promoted to be the youngest detective in the police department. When one of his cases goes completely wrong, he stands accused of murder, and must race to clear his name.

programme.title: Queens of Dope City
programme.desc: Joselyn, Kendra and Alicia are partners in a rideshare service they have created together, but are struggling financially to maintain the business. One day Joselyn gives a man named Donte a ride who presents her with an opportunity to keep the business going. Things then begin to spiral out of control when they soon are chased down from the law, and must escape Donte.

programme.desc: Destitute and desperate, China is forced to the edge, taking up work as a truck stop sex worker just to survive. programme.title: Ernani
programme.desc: En Espagne, au XVIe siècle. Follement amoureux de la belle Elvire, Ernani vit en proscrit dans le maquis avec une troupe de rebelles dont il est le chef. La nuit, il parvient à obtenir des rendez-vous secrets avec sa bien-aimée. Alors que le coeur d'Elvire ne bat que pour Ernani, Silva, un vieil oncle de la jeune femme, qui désire l'épouser, tente de la soumettre à sa volonté. A ce rival s'en ajoute un autre en la personne du jeune roi don Carlos...

programme.title: Richard Wagner et les juifs
programme.desc: Richard Wagner était notoirement antisémite, et ses écrits sur les Juifs ont ensuite été adoptés par Hitler et les nazis. Mais pendant des années, bon nombre des associés les plus proches de Wagner étaient des Juifs - de jeunes musiciens qui se sont personnellement dévoués à lui et ont apporté une aide cruciale à son travail et à sa carrière. Pourquoi étaient-ils attirés par lui ?

programme.title: "Betroffenheit" de Crystal Pite
programme.desc: Ce ballet est inspiré des événements tragiques vécus par le chorégraphe Jonathon Young lors de vacances en famille particulièrement douloureuses, au cours desquels il perd sa fille, son neveu et sa nièce dans un incendie. Mêlant claquettes, salsa, dialogues, chant et spectacle de marionnettes, il relate un drame personnel intérieur, transposé sur les planches du Sadler's Wells Theatre de Londres.

programme.title: Claudio Abbado, Berliner Philharmoniker : Verdi
programme.desc: Composée par Verdi en hommage à Alessandro Manzoni, chantre de l'unité italienne, la Messe de requiem est créée sous la direction du compositeur en l'église Saint-Marc de Milan pour le premier anniversaire de la mort de Manzoni. Le succès fut immédiat. Depuis, l'oeuvre fait partie du répertoire classique. Claudio Abbado l'a dirigée en 2001 à la Philharmonie de Berlin.
